Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)
Class: Sniper Rifle
Range: Anti-Material Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Loads only its own modified Armor-Piercing ammo (100eb (Premium) per round), which also counts as Burrowing. Its rounds carry damage through cover the way Explosives do. Firing without being knocked Prone and suffering Broken Ribs requires BODY 13+, or BODY 11+ while Prone, or a mount. Can never be silenced or suppressed.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
